desc: The Fatih 380 brings back the iconic Model 84 with Tisas styling and quality. A tribute to the original design, the Fatih B380 uses a 13-round magazine that provides an incredible amount of firepower for the smaller .380 ACP cartridge and features an all-metal frame and slide. Equipped with fixed sights, push-button magazine release, ambidextrous manual safety, and the black grips have a bit of checkering that provides beautiful aesthetics as well as enhanced weapon control.
